senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of חוך)to rub, polish, finish; trnsf. to train; to dedicate.

to train, initiate (a child); to inaugurate, prepare for office; to dedicate. Y. Yoma I, 38ᵇ top … מה מְחַנְּכִין אותו וכ׳ as the Highpriest’s inauguration lasted seven days (Lev. VIII, 33, sq.), so is the Highpriest prepared for the service of the Day of Atonement seven days.
units: <cite ref="Nazir 29a:11">Naz. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי לחַנְּכוֹ במצות</he> in order to initiate his son into the performance of religious duties.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:4">Yoma VIII, 4</cite>; Tosef. ib. V (IV), 2 <he>מְחַנְּכִין וכ׳</he> you must train them gradually (to fast on the Day of Atonement) a year or two before religious maturity.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:6">M. Kat. I, 6</cite> <he>מח׳ את הכוכין וכ׳</he> you may finish up the excavated chambers; v. <cite ref="H00819"><he>חִינּוּךְ</he></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 964:19">Yalk. Prov. 964</cite> <he>יצחק ח׳ וכ׳</he>; Pesik. Baḥod., p. 101ᵃ <he>יצחק נתח׳ וכ׳</he> Isaac was initiated into the covenant on his eighth day. Sifra Vayikra, Ḥoba, ch. III, Par. 3 <he>שיִתְחַנֵּךְ המזבח וכ׳</he> that the altar must be dedicated by offering frankincense.
